stanzas: Plaisir d’amour ne dure qu’un moment,
Chagrin d’amour dure toute la vie.
J’ai tout quitté pour l’ingrate Sylvie,
Elle me quitte et prend un autre amant.
Plaisir d’amour ne dure qu’un moment,
Chagrin d’amour dure toute la vie.
Tant que cette eau coulera doucement
Vers ce ruisseau qui borde la prairie,
Je t’aimerai, me répétait Sylvie…
L’eau coule encor, elle a changé pourtant !
Plaisir d’amour ne dure qu’un moment,
Chagrin d’amour dure toute la vie.
orig.credit: Jean-Pierre Claris de Florian (1784), as printed in La Chanson française du XVe au XXe siècle
orig.page: La Chanson française du XVe au XXe siècle/Plaisir d’amour

stanzas: The pleasure of love lasts only a moment,
the sorrow of love lasts all one's life.
I gave up everything for ungrateful Sylvie;
she leaves me and takes another lover.
The pleasure of love lasts only a moment,
the sorrow of love lasts all one's life.
"As long as this water flows gently
toward the stream that borders the meadow,
I will love you," Sylvie kept telling me…
The water still flows, yet she has changed!
The pleasure of love lasts only a moment,
the sorrow of love lasts all one's life.

notes: The English follows a translation by the Institute's editor, fitted to the lines as printed.
The poem is a song in Florian's novella Célestine (1784).
